entities.name: Time Rifts
entities.description: Fractures in the planar fabric of Dominaria caused by catastrophes, most involving planeswalkers, that cut off mana and distort time until sealed in the Mending.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The Nexus plane whose rifts, if unrepaired, would destroy every other plane in a chain reaction.

entities.name: Madara
entities.description: The continent where the first planeswalker battle on Dominaria occurred.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: An elder dragon planeswalker whose ancient fight caused the Madaran rift and who closes it using Leshrac's powers.

entities.name: Leshrac
entities.description: A planeswalker whose powers influence the closing of several rifts and who is killed when Bolas closes the Madaran rift.

entities.name: Ravi
entities.description: The figure who rang the Apocalypse Chime.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: A planeswalker whose Sylex Blast and failed time experiment caused rifts.

entities.name: Multani
entities.description: The sentient forest spirit trapped in the Yavimayan rift and later rescued by Venser.

entities.name: Venser
entities.description: A planeswalker who rescues Multani and helps Jeska close the Otarian rift.

entities.name: Jeska
entities.description: A character who, influenced by Leshrac, uses Radha's spark to seal rifts and finally closes the Otarian rift.

entities.name: Radha
entities.description: A warlord whose unignited spark is used to seal rifts, losing her potential to become a planeswalker.

entities.name: Barrin
entities.description: The mage who obliterated Tolaria, worsening the Tolarian rift.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: A planeswalker who travels back in time to mend the Tolarian rift and helps persuade Windgrace.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: A planeswalker who phased out Shiv and Zhalfir and sacrifices his spark to heal the Shivan rift.

entities.name: Freyalise
entities.description: A planeswalker who relocated Skyshroud Forest and gives her life to seal the Skyshroud rift.

entities.name: Lord Windgrace
entities.description: The lord of Urborg who gives his life to heal the Urborg rift.

entities.name: Karona
entities.description: The incarnation of Dominarian magic, whose destruction at the climax of Karona's War created the Otarian rift.

entities.name: Konda
entities.description: The figure who steals That Which Was Taken on Kamigawa, beginning the Kami War.

entities.name: Memnarch
entities.description: Used the rifts' effects to prevent Karn from entering Mirrodin.

entities.name: Mending
entities.description: The healing of Dominaria and the multiverse that began once the last major rift was sealed.

entities.name: Yavimaya
entities.description: The sentient forest whose rift trapped Multani.

entities.name: Shiv
entities.description: A region Teferi phased out, creating the Shivan rift.

entities.name: Zhalfir
entities.description: A nation phased out by Teferi, forever lost after its rift was sealed.

entities.name: Urborg
entities.description: A land with a rift caused as a side effect of the Rathi Overlay.

entities.name: Skyshroud Forest
entities.description: A forest relocated by Freyalise whose rift she seals with her life.

entities.name: Tolaria
entities.description: The island where the Tolarian rift formed.

entities.name: Otaria
entities.description: The land with the widespread Otarian rift.

entities.name: Kamigawa
entities.description: A plane where the veil between utsushiyo and kakuriyo weakened.

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: A plane whose mana core was destabilized by the rifts.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: A plane that became isolated from the Multiverse as a result of the rifts.

events.summary: Nicol Bolas and a demonic leviathan fight the first planeswalker battle on Dominaria, destroying a third of the continent and causing the first temporal damage.
events.quote: Their battle destroyed one-third of the continent and caused the first temporal damage to the plane.

events.summary: Ravi rings the Apocalypse Chime, propagating damage across planes.
events.quote: When Ravi rang the Apocalypse Chime

events.summary: Urza's Sylex Blast damages the plane and the sentient forest of Yavimaya traps Multani in its rift.
events.quote: instead causing Multani to become trapped in the rift.

events.summary: Urza's failed time experiment creates the Tolarian rift, felt immediately.
events.quote: the Tolarian rift was felt immediately after it came into being

events.summary: Barrin obliterates Tolaria, worsening the Tolarian rift beyond repair.
events.quote: the rift was worsened beyond repair when Barrin obliterated all of Tolaria

events.summary: Teferi phases out part of Shiv, leaving a hole in Dominaria.
Teferi heals the Shivan rift, the first to close, sacrificing his spark.
events.quote: Teferi successfully healed the damage, sacrificing his spark in the process.

events.summary: Teferi phases out Zhalfir entirely, opening the Zhalfir rift.
events.quote: In an instant, Zhalfir and all its people, animals, plants, buildings, and even the landmass itself, were phased out.

events.summary: The Rathi Overlay opens the Urborg rift as a side effect.
events.quote: A shadow dragon and Phyrexians from an alternate timeline in which the Ice Age never ended came through the rift while it was active.

events.summary: Freyalise relocates Skyshroud Forest, creating its rift.
events.quote: Freyalise relocated it from its unnamed initial destination

events.summary: Karona is destroyed at the climax of Karona's War, creating the Otarian rift.
events.quote: The last major rift to come into existence was created at the climax of Karona's War

events.summary: Venser rescues Multani from the Yavimayan rift and Jeska seals it with Radha's spark, which burns out.
events.quote: Radha's spark burned out, causing the warlord to lose her potential to become a planeswalker.

events.summary: Karn travels back in time and mends the Tolarian rift just before Barrin's spell.
events.quote: it was necessary for Karn to travel back in time and mend the rift just before Barrin cast his obliteration spell.

events.summary: The Zhalfir rift is sealed, forever losing Zhalfir from Dominaria.
events.quote: sealing the rift closed the nation off from being able to return

events.summary: Lord Windgrace gives up his life to heal the Urborg rift.
events.quote: he gave up his life to heal the rift

events.summary: Freyalise gives her life to seal the Skyshroud rift and the forest dies with her.
events.quote: Freyalise gave her life to seal the rift

events.summary: Nicol Bolas closes the Madaran rift, killing Leshrac.
events.quote: The rift was closed second to last by Nicol Bolas

events.summary: With the Otarian rift closed by Jeska, the Great Mending begins.
events.quote: With the last major rift sealed, the Great Mending began.

relations.note: Closing the rift using Leshrac's powers killed him.
relations.quote: killing the Nightwalker in the process
Venser rescued Multani from the rift

relations.note: Karona is the incarnation of Dominarian magic.
Konda's theft began the Kami War.
relations.quote: This enabled Konda to steal That Which Was Taken
